subject: URGENT: Emergency Early Dismissal Today - Power Outage - Pick Up Students by 1:00 PM
text_body:
URGENT MESSAGE FROM PRINCIPAL MARTINEZ

Dear Lincoln Elementary Families,

Due to a widespread power outage affecting our campus and the surrounding neighborhood, we must implement an emergency early dismissal TODAY, May 12, 2026.

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO:
- Please pick up your child(ren) from school NO LATER THAN 1:00 PM today
- Enter through the front office and sign out your student
- If you cannot pick up your child, please call the office immediately at (650) 555-0147 so we can arrange supervision
- Students not picked up by 1:00 PM will be moved to the district office at 25 Churchill Avenue

IMPORTANT DETAILS:
- The power company estimates restoration by 4:00 PM, but we cannot safely operate without power for heating, lighting, and kitchen facilities
- All after-school programs including Kids Club, tutoring, and sports are CANCELLED today
- Lunch will still be served before dismissal
- Bus transportation will NOT be available for early dismissal

We understand this is an inconvenience and appreciate your quick response. The safety of our students is our top priority.

We will send an update this evening regarding tomorrow's schedule.

Dr. Robert Martinez
Principal, Lincoln Elementary School
(650) 555-0147
